detail: numpy neg-binom + zero-inflation simulation (1000 genes × 2000 cells, 100 true DEGs, 30% dropout). 5 method combinations with signal-detection DEG model: audit scores 55–85, F1 0.039–0.639. Spearman ρ = 0.9747, Kendall τ_b = 0.9487. Monotonic ranking: True.
limit: n=5 combinations (small n, correlation directionally meaningful but p-values unreliable). Signal-detection model (not actual tool execution — splatter unavailable due to Bioconductor GFW block). Model parameters grounded in benchmark literature (Hafemeister 2019, Squair 2021, Tran 2020, Xi 2021). Directional validation: audit scores track analysis quality. Honest limitation: modeled F1 rather than empirical F1 from tool execution.
